name: Home Assistant, Sensor
description: One or more Home Assistant entities as bold value blocks. A single entity fills the cell as a hero number with a trend arrow + 24h sparkline beneath; several lay out as a list with per-row trend + hairline sparkline. Lead glyph picks up the device-class (temperature → thermometer, CO₂ → wind, current → wave-sine, money → coin, etc.). Requires the Home Assistant Core plugin.

cell_options.name: show_title
cell_options.label: Show title row
cell_options.help: Off hides the whole title row (icon + name), so a single entity shows just its value.

cell_options.name: overrides
cell_options.label: Custom names + icons + number format
cell_options.help: One row per ticked entity. Leave the name blank to keep the auto label; pick "No icon" to keep the auto icon. The format box overrides the widget number format for that entity (blank = use the widget default).

cell_options.name: number_format
cell_options.label: Number format
cell_options.help: How numeric values are shown. Blank rounds to 2 decimals and trims trailing zeros (21.00 → 21). Use 0 for whole numbers, 0.0 for one decimal, 0.00 for two, and so on. Per-entity overrides live in the row above.

cell_options.name: show_names
cell_options.label: Show entity names (list rows)
cell_options.help: Off hides the per-row entity name when several entities are listed, leaving icon + value.

cell_options.name: show_trend
cell_options.label: Show trend arrow (up / down / flat vs 24h)
